title: Existence and upper semicontinuity of the density for Lᵖ mean curvature (Simon 4.9; parent Step 6)
statement: Assume (GF) [as in bounded_curvature] and the contract proposition LpMonotonicity. Then LpDensity holds: for n > 0, ℓ, V, open U, H such that V has generalized mean curvature H in U, and p > n with H ∈ L^p_loc(U) (H ∈ L^p(μ_V⌞K) for every compact K ⊆ U), V.HasDensityAt ξ (V.density ξ) for every ξ ∈ U and V.density is upper semicontinuous on U.
lean_statement: (∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ), 0 < n → IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts V.weight ∧ (∀ᵐ x ∂V.weight, Module.finrank ℝ (V.tangentSpace x) = n) ∧ AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x ↦ (V.tangentSpace x).starProjection) V.weight) → LpMonotonicity → LpDensity
